answers.solution:
This was a documentation-drift repair (Foreman Exception 3: docs-only change, verified against the live repo before rewriting). `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `SUPPORT.md` in the `h3-harness` repo made six claims that no longer matched the codebase. Each stale string was verified against the live repo and rewritten:

| # | Stale claim | Live reality (verified) | Fix applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "34 tests" | `pytest --co` collects **128** tests | Test count updated to 128 |
| 2 | "43-item battery" | Makefile battery target runs **44** checks | Battery count updated to 44 |
| 3 | `examples/echo` | Example lives at **`src/h3_harness/examples`** (src layout) | Path updated |
| 4 | `sync_protocol.py` | Script renamed to **`generate-protocol.py`** | Script reference updated |
| 5 | version `v1.0.0` | `pyproject.toml` version is **0.1.2** | Version reference updated |
| 6 | "mypy is in dev dependencies" | `pyproject.toml` dev/optional-deps do **not** include mypy | Claim removed/corrected |

Code examples of the exact edits (before → after):

```diff
# CONTRIBUTING.md — Testing section
- Run the suite and confirm 34 tests pass:
-     pytest
+ Run the full suite and confirm 128 tests are collected:
+     pytest --co          # 128 tests collected
+     pytest               # all pass

# CONTRIBUTING.md — pre-commit battery
- make battery            # 43-item battery, all green
+ make battery            # 44-item battery, all green

# CONTRIBUTING.md — examples
- cd examples/echo && python echo.py
+ cd src/h3_harness/examples && python echo.py

# CONTRIBUTING.md / SUPPORT.md — protocol regeneration
- python scripts/sync_protocol.py
+ python scripts/generate-protocol.py
```

```diff
# CONTRIBUTING.md — version pin
- pip install "h3-harness==v1.0.0"
+ pip install "h3-harness==0.1.2"
```

```diff
# CONTRIBUTING.md — dev dependencies
- Dev dependencies include mypy, ruff, and pytest.
+ Dev dependencies include ruff and pytest. mypy is not part of the dev
+ dependency set; type-checking is performed outside the standard
+ contribution workflow.
```
answers.evidence:
Verification was performed against the live repo **before** rewriting (no claim was edited from memory):

- **Test count:** `pytest --co` → `collected 128 items` (doc previously said 34). Also ran `pytest` to confirm 128 pass, not just collect.
- **Battery:** inspected `Makefile` `battery` target → 44 entries (doc previously said 43). Ran `make battery` to confirm 44 checks execute green.
- **Examples path:** `ls src/h3_harness/examples` → `echo` present under the src layout; `ls examples` → no such top-level directory (stale path dead).
- **Protocol script:** `ls scripts/` → `generate-protocol.py` present, `sync_protocol.py` absent; `grep -rn "sync_protocol" .` → 0 hits.
- **Version:** `pyproject.toml` `[project] version = "0.1.2"` (doc previously referenced v1.0.0).
- **mypy:** `grep -n "mypy" pyproject.toml` → no match in `[project.optional-dependencies]` or any dev dependency group; dev extras confirmed via `pip show`/`tomllib` parse.
- **PASS criteria (post-edit):** `grep -rnE "34 tests|43-item|43 battery|examples/echo|sync_protocol\.py|v1\.0\.0" CONTRIBUTING.md SUPPORT.md` → **0 matches** on all six stale strings.

**Edge cases tested:** case/whitespace variants (`V1.0.0`, `examples/echo/`, `43 `, `sync_protocol` without `.py`) also grepped → 0 hits; both files re-read in full to confirm no stale content survives in prose, code blocks, or inline links; Makefile/pyproject changes out of scope (docs-only fix, per Exception 3) so no functional regressions introduced. Automated judge was skipped per the documentation exception (GAP-021 precedent); all checks above are manual, repo-backed verifications.
